target.title: fix(ci): bound docs-sync publish repo git fetch with timeout
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The two `git fetch origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main` calls in `.github/workflows/docs-sync-publish.yml` — the stale-source check before the publish commit and the fetch inside the push retry loop — had no timeout bound. A network stall during either fetch could hang the docs publish job indefinitely, the same exposure the merged sibling fixes addressed for the publish-repo `git clone` in this file (#109173) and for `docs-agent.yml` fetches (#110026).

## Why This Change Was Made

Both fetches now run under `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 120s`, the exact wrapper shape already merged for this file's clone (#109173), `docs-agent.yml` (#110026), `linux-app-release.yml` (#110027), and `macos-release.yml` (#109174). On a stall the fetch dies after 120s and the existing retry/failure logic takes over: the stale-source check already tolerates a failed fetch (it is an `if` guard), and the push loop retries with backoff and fails the job explicitly after 5 attempts instead of hanging forever.

## Changes

- Wrap both `git fetch origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main` invocations with `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 120s` (2 lines).

## User Impact

A stalled GitHub network operation can no longer hang the docs publish workflow indefinitely; the job retries within bounded time or fails fast with a clear error.

## Evidence

Exact head: a6b076ffc59e7b172c20c63e945e61861b496c2d.

**Controlled-runtime proof** — a real local git repo whose `origin` is a blackhole TCP server (accepts the connection, never responds), reproducing a stalled Git transport. The shell shapes under test are copied verbatim from the workflow run blocks; run as a file under `bash` (so `set -euo pipefail` semantics are real).

Part 1 — the exact wrapper terminates a stalled `git fetch` at the 120s bound (exit 124):

```text
=== PART 1: exact wrapper (timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 120s) terminates a stalled git fetch ===
[proof] part1: exit=124 elapsed=120s (124 = killed by timeout(1))
[proof] part1 ok: stalled fetch was terminated by the wrapper
```

Part 2 — the stale-source guard (run-block lines 120-122, verbatim shape): a bounded fetch failure skips `skip_stale_source` and the step proceeds down its normal path:

```text
=== PART 2: workflow stale-source guard (run-block lines 120-122, verbatim shape) ===
[proof] part2: fetch failed bounded -> skip_stale_source_called=no, flow continued to commit/push path
[proof] part2 ok: failed fetch skips the stale-source check and the job proceeds down its normal path
```

Part 3 — the push retry loop (run-block lines 128-138, verbatim loop; only the timeout duration compressed 120s→3s to keep the demo short, wrapper flags unchanged): all 5 attempts die at the bound, the loop exhausts, and the step reaches its explicit failure path instead of hanging:

```text
=== PART 3: workflow push retry loop (run-block lines 128-138, verbatim loop; timeout shortened 120s->3s ONLY to compress the demo, wrapper flags unchanged) ===
Publish sync attempt 1 failed; retrying.
Publish sync attempt 2 failed; retrying.
Publish sync attempt 3 failed; retrying.
Publish sync attempt 4 failed; retrying.
Publish sync attempt 5 failed; retrying.
Failed to push publish-repo sync after retries.
[proof] part3: exit=1 elapsed=45s (5 attempts x 3s + backoff 2+4+6+8+10=30s)
[proof] part3 ok: loop exhausted 5 bounded attempts then failed explicitly (no indefinite hang)

[proof] ALL PARTS PASS
```

Merge-base freshness: the most recent upstream change to `.github/workflows/docs-sync-publish.yml` is 64dd2535dcc (#109173), which is an ancestor of this branch's base; the file shape this proof was run against is identical to current `main`.

- Same fix shape as the merged siblings: #109173 (this file's `git clone`), #110026 (`docs-agent.yml` fetches), #110027 (`linux-app-release.yml`), #109174 (`macos-release.yml`) — identical `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 120s` wrapper.
- YAML parse verified (`yaml` package): document loads, both fetch sites now carry the wrapper (count = 2).
- `git diff --check` clean.
- Existing workflow assertions pass:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run test/scripts/docs-sync-publish.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
```

- What was not tested: a live CI run (same proof scope as the merged siblings).

## Intentionally out of scope

- Other unbounded `git fetch` sites in `ci.yml` and the `mantis-*.yml` QA workflows; keeping this PR to the docs-sync-publish sibling scope of #109173.
- No change to retry counts, sleep backoff, refspecs, or failure handling.
